_comment: Single source of truth for featured projects. Verified against the GitHub API (public, not archived, README present) on 2026-10-26. After editing, run: python3 scripts/sync_projects.py

featured.name: stream-able
featured.description: An OBS-like recording, livestreaming and multistreaming studio that runs inside Minecraft, with interactive Chromium browser sources composited over gameplay.

featured.name: blurcam
featured.description: A native C++20 Linux CLI that blurs, pixelates or distorts faces locally. No accounts, cloud inference or telemetry.

featured.name: ghostfx
featured.description: 250+ original animated GLSL shaders for the Ghostty terminal, with a CLI that installs them safely and a Home Manager module.

featured.name: ai-media-cli
featured.description: A local-first media CLI suite: Qwen image generation and editing, a 3D asset pipeline, video jobs and music generation. Model weights are not bundled.

featured.name: nixpresence
featured.description: A NixOS-friendly VRChat OSC chatbox compositor with an optional Discord Rich Presence daemon.

featured.name: dotfiles
featured.description: A deep-space niri desktop for NixOS: palette-driven configs, an SDDM theme and a procedural nebula wallpaper.

more.name: opsec-check
more.description: Read-only privacy and OPSEC audit CLI for Linux.

more.name: matrix
more.description: Realtime Matrix-style digital rain for the terminal.

more.name: KeystrokeNoise
more.description: Mechanical keyboard and mouse click sounds for Linux.

more.name: nulltype-font
more.description: An original chamfered monospace font under the OFL.
